protocol.scope: Exploratory follow-up selected after initial DUFOMap paired cells were seen; not a held-out test or H1 validation.
protocol.decision: Compare simple parameter guards with original settings, keeping static loss and dynamic recall together. A finite threshold scan is not full risk-coverage-delay matching. No parameter is selected for a held-out result.
